name: TaxCloud
summary: TaxCloud sells US sales tax reporting and filing for online sellers, with filing subscriptions starting at $39 a month or plans as low as $20 per filing. Starter plans cover reports and nexus monitoring, while real-time rate calculation and API access sit on Premium. Filing is free for sellers in Streamlined Sales Tax states where they have no physical presence.

facts.text: TaxCloud lists a 30-day free trial of Premium features with no credit card required.
Paying by credit card adds a 7% convenience fee.
Filings above a plan's allotment are billed at the plan's per-filing rate, plus surcharges for Colorado, Louisiana and Washington B&O taxes.
State registration is offered as an extra service with no price listed, and audit support starts at $99 a month.
TaxCloud says that through Streamlined Sales Tax, filing and registration are free in 24 states.
